UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user's public profile information.

photoURL.description: URL of the user's profile picture.

currentStreak.description: The user's current daily check-in streak.

longestStreak.description: The user's longest daily check-in streak.

lastCheckInDate.description: The last date the user checked in, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores public user profile data, keyed by user ID.
